01The four fields you reason with

The task card names the model directly. Kind says what the entity is. A workflow supplies named statuses; each status belongs to exactly one hardcoded category. The board’s columns are the workflow.

  • kind: task selects task behavior and state shape.
  • status is workflow data: the word your team uses.
  • category is the four-value law: to_do, in_progress, done, or cancelled.
  • workflow names the allowed status set and its birth state.
Version skew, stated.The deployed stable server can still expose task axis, a retired surface. Latest main uses kind + status + category + workflow. This Help page follows latest main and does not teach axes.

02The two CLI verbs in the proof

Juniper uses the task lifecycle command short of completion. Callisto uses a bounded, side-effect-free context read. done remains special: only task complete may write it, after acceptance criteria pass.

status writedurable
tm8 task transition <task-id> in_review
Moves a task short of completion.
bounded readno side effect
tm8 entity context <task-id> --sections summary --format json
Returns tm8.entity-context.v1 with root.version.

The mock names are fictional Northlake data. The command syntax, entity kinds, status spelling, categories, output envelope, and version behavior follow tm8’s verified contracts.
